blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — The Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) is seeking the public’s help in locating a fisherman reported missing at sea off Paluan, Occidental Mindoro. In a public appeal posted on Sunday, Oct. 18, the Coast Guard Station Occidental Mindoro identified the missing man as Joshua Matugas, a resident of Barangay Tayamaan in Mamburao town. Matugas was reported missing in the waters off Sitio Kalangigan in Barangay Harrison, Paluan, the Coast Guard said.
